name: Celestial Vindicator Helm
description: A magnificent helm forged from glowing white metal and polished silver. It radiates a warm, holy light, protecting the wearer's mind with divine yellow energy.

name: Celestial Vindicator Cuirass
description: A heavy breastplate of radiant white and silver steel. Ornate yellow trims glow with celestial power, absorbing the darkest of blows.

name: Celestial Vindicator Gauntlets
description: Elegant silver gauntlets with glowing white plates. The fingertips and knuckles are tipped with radiant yellow essence.

name: Celestial Vindicator Leggings
description: Heavily plated greaves forged from white-gold alloys and silver. They feel weightless while providing impenetrable holy defense.

name: Celestial Vindicator Sabatons
description: Solid silver boots inlaid with glowing white runes. Each step leaves a faint trail of radiant yellow dust.

name: Celestial Vindicator Cloak
description: A magnificent cloak of shimmering white silk with silver embroidery. A radiant yellow seal is pinned at the shoulder, guiding the faithful.
